editorial: When the iconic framework of the slasher genre begins to crumble, the horror remains brutal and immediate. This entry into the horror genre makes you consider not just surviving a killer, but surviving the cultural weight of your own trauma. The standout element here is how the meta-commentary occasionally gives way to genuinely terrifying, gut-punch practical scares, elevating the material beyond mere fan service. While the pacing drags slightly during the central mystery arc, the vicious final act propels the action into a relentless, frightening conclusion. You will leave the cinema recognizing this film as a surprisingly raw and tense exploration of legacy.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of meta-horror who appreciate a mix of sharp dialogue and bloody consequences.
